purpose: lists, shows, and edits your workspaces, and says which one kit starts on

--text.description: prints as text, even on a terminal

--json.description: one JSON object, as each form below says

--jq.description: the same JSON, formatted by jq for a person

--show.description: shows a workspace's members, each with its checkout

--current.description: says which workspace kit starts on here, and why; under kit --workspace=<workspace>, the kit option before the verb, that one in place of where kit runs, none naming no workspace, and an absolute path the repository whose working tree holds it

--use.description: remembers a group as the last used, which kit starts on outside a repository; given a <folder>, keeps the repository whose working tree holds it first among the recent ones, by its desk, a linked worktree's its repository's, ten at most, which the workspace menu offers

--new.description: makes a group, with the repositories given as its members

--add.description: adds the repositories to a group's members

--remove.description: takes the repositories out of a group's members

--rename.description: gives a group a new name, in its place in the file, and keeps it the last used if it was

--delete.description: takes a group, and its favorite, out of the file, and forgets it as the last used; its checkouts are as they were

--from.description: runs the command, by bash from where kit runs, each line it prints a repository, as a member, a git URL, or a checkout's directory, as gh repo list <owner> --json url --jq '.[].url' prints them: they join the group, or, with a pattern among the repositories, those it matches

--favorite.description: adds a workspace to the favorites

--unfavorite.description: takes a workspace out of the favorites

<workspace>.description: a group's name, or a repository: github.com/empowerite/edge or a git URL; for --use, a <folder> too

<name>.description: a group's name: a lowercase letter or a digit, then lowercase letters, digits, and . _ -, and never none

<new-name>.description: the name --rename gives the group, as a <name> is written and no other group's

<repository>.description: github.com/empowerite/edge, a git URL, or a checkout's directory; or a pattern, which holds *, ?, or [, as github.com/empowerite/homebrew-*: the repositories it matches among what --from printed, else, for --remove, the group's members, else the checkouts under the roots; one that matches none is refused

<folder>.description: a folder in a git working tree, written as a path: it starts with /, ./, ../, or ~/, or is ., .., or ~
